description: This file implements a report for trial balance by party in the ERPNext system, including functions for data retrieval, calculations, and report column definitions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, validating filters and retrieving columns and data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles party balances data based on filters.

methods.name: get_opening_balances
methods.description: Fetches opening balances for parties before the start date.

methods.name: get_balances_within_period
methods.description: Fetches balances for parties within the specified date range.

methods.name: toggle_debit_credit
methods.description: Adjusts debit and credit amounts to reflect net balances.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the trial balance report.

methods.name: is_party_name_visible
methods.description: Determines whether to show party name based on party type and settings.
